s: Qodem sheyyitpallel tzarik lishhot ubo d' seipim: hammitpallel tzarik sheyyishheh bammaqom shemmitpallel shaa achat qodem tepillato, kede sheyyekavven libbo lammaqom, shenneemar: "ashre yoshebe beteka" veachar kak "yehaleluka sela", veshaa achat achar tepillato, shello tehe niret alayv kemasseoy shemmemaher latzet mimmenna, shenneemar: "ak tzaddiqim yodu lishmeka" veachar kak "yeshebu yesharim et paneka". Vachasidim harishonim hayu shohin shaa mammash mishshaot benonit, shehen k"d bemeet leet, velishar am day beshaa muetet kede hilluk b' petachim shehem ch' tepachim, kemo shennitbaer besiman tz'. Yesh nohagin lehitpallel mittok hasseper, kede lekavven meod. Vehakkol lepi mah shehu margish benapsho:

En omedin lehitpallel ella mittok kobed rosh, shehi haknaa meemat haqqabba"h, shenneemar: "ibdu et Hashem beyira", dehaynu hattepilla, shehi lanu bimqom aboda — asu otah beyira. Velo yaamod lo mittok sechoq veqallut rosh udebarim betelim, velo mittok kaas, ella mittok simcha shel mitzva, kegon dibre tanchumim shel tora, kegon samuk ligullat mitzrayim, o samuk li"tehilla ledavid" shekkatub bo: "retzon yereayv yaaseh … shomer Hashem et kol ohabayv":

En omedin lehitpallel mittok din velo mittok halaka, shello yehe libbo tarud bah bitpillato velo yukal lekavven yapeh, ella mittok halaka pesuqa, sheen lepalpel bah kelum velo yittared bah battepilla, vehi niqret gam ken simcha shel mitzva, shenneemar: "piqqude Hashem yesharim mesammeche leb". Umikkol maqom, im asaq bepilpul halaka vehitchilu tzibbur lehitpallel — yitpallel immahem, ubiprat akshav sheen mekavvenim kol kak battepilla. Velo hizhiru ella lekattechilla, shello yaasoq bepilpul qodem hattepilla:

Haoseq betzorke tzibbur — hare zeh keoseq battora. Yesh meporshim leinyan laamod mittoko lehitpallel, sheggam zo simcha hi lo sheoseq betzorke tzibbur, ubilbad sheyyehe dabar sheen bo tirda, domeh lahalaka pesuqa. Veyesh meporshim leinyan sheen tzarik lipsoq ulehitpallel, kemo shehaoseq battora vetorato ummanuto — en tzarik lipsoq litpilla. Ukebar nitbaer besiman a' shehaoseq betzorke tzibbur apillu liqriat shema eno poseq, vekol shekken litpilla. Veen tzarik lehitpallel mincha shettayim bishbil tashlume shacharit, shekkevan shebbishat chobato haya patur mimmenna min haddin — en tzarik letashlumin kelal:
